newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yemen offers crude for sale in Q1 1997 - traders.
newsitem.headline: Yemen offers crude for sale in Q1 1997 - traders.

text.p: Yemen has invited bids for crude oil sales for the January-March quarter of 1997, traders said on Wednesday.
Yemen offered Marib Light and Masila crude but did not specify the volume, they said.
Bids must be placed by 1500 GMT on November 25 and be valid until 1500 GMT on December 5.
The oil producer has asked for the bids to be linked to dated Brent, which is the usual practice. However, it also said that it is prepared to accept other price formulas.
Traders said Far East traders might consider a Dubai-linked formula. Dubai is the benchmark in Asia.
Yemen exports about 100,000 barrels a day (bpd) of Masila and 30,000 bpd of Marib Light to Japanese, South Korean and European buyers.
